purpose: Certify the reduced H3/Z20 window-local particular state using independently solved on-shell H1 parents at Nt128 primary and Nt64 control, the unchanged Repair14 quadratic source, the unchanged Repair18 projected boundary, and a preregistered shift certification that separates active rows from structurally near-null rows without relaxing the original active 1e-6 threshold.

primary_control.m0: source/backreaction report only; no homogeneous solve

on_shell_H1.construction: independently solve frozen Repair13 reduced H1 equations on Nt128 and Nt64 using frozen GE15/GE18 initial bridge and Repair11 Lambda c1

H3.boundary: unchanged Repair18 q0=0 projected-p0 boundary independently reconstructed on both time grids
H3.integrator: unchanged Repair07 two-stage Radau IIA canonical march

shift_certification.reason: Repair20/21 established that O(1) maxima occur when both residual and natural scale are machine-level near zero
shift_certification.S_ref: maximum natural shift scale over the complete Nt128 primary set
shift_certification.control_mapping: PCHIP Nt64 shift metric to Nt128 independently for each fixed C,beta,m

required_reports: Nt128 Nx1024/Nx2048 source low-mode relative L2 convergence
source decomposition by GA, dust, Lambda and Y2
original all-row shift maxima at Nt128/Nt64
active and near-null shift sample counts
active shift Linf and RMS/L2 on matched Nt128 grid
linear-system, anisotropy and state time-grid controls
NPZ with certified candidate Z20 primary/control, on-shell H1 parents, sources and shift telemetry

routing.PASS: all H1, source-spatial, boundary, active-shift, near-null, matched-order, state-time, linear, anisotropy, completeness and finite-output gates pass
routing.FAIL: one or more frozen certification gates fail after successful implementation
routing.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: frozen provenance, on-shell H1 reconstruction, source reconstruction, boundary reconstruction or execution fails

next_step_if_PASS: Freeze Z20 as the certified reduced window-local particular second-order baseline. Then construct q20 in a separately preregistered step before H4/Z21.
claim_boundary: A PASS certifies only the low-mode constraint-certified window-local reduced-H3 Z20 particular directional state on the Repair13 self-consistent background. It does not certify a primordial/homogeneous second-order mode, full species, finite eta, physical-amplitude nonlinear evolution or observables.
